'''Rokarian dirt-fish fillet sandwiches''' were a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] containing a [[Rokarian dirt-fish fillet]]. They were served with a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] as a [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran plate special]] on [[Benduday/Legends|Bendudays]] at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 6.1 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rokarian dirt-fish fillet sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
